usual_baseline: FBC is near 100% [3226, 3386, 3465]. Lipids are usually checked (81–92%) [3089, 3378], but cardiovascular risk is not: QRISK3 0% [3089], risk score 3.70% [3378]. Lipids sent to GP 18.18% [3378]. Older adults: glucose, prolactin and lipids 0% [3386]. Initiation: no routine troponin, baseline ECG 80% [3676]; pre-treatment troponin 14%, CRP 0% [3465].
fix_that_works: 20-minute nurse training on three days plus an aide-memoire: inappropriate clozapine tests fell from 53% to none, with routine FBCs for all [3408]. A ward already using a monitoring checklist achieved 100% adherence [3252].
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits
consultant_advice: FBC monitoring is safe and not worth auditing again. The gaps are cardiovascular risk scoring, sending results to the GP, and troponin and CRP during initiation. Most audits here never re-audited, so close the loop on one of those.
